name: uplift-ui
description: Restyle an existing web frontend into a modern, responsive interface with its own identity, without breaking its behaviour. Tokens with light/dark, 12 palettes, 4 flavours, ~80 motion classes, popups, info tips, searchable paged tables, empty states, illustrations, modern surfaces, ready-made blocks (panels, table styles, sign-in layouts with SSO, two-step code and password strength), React components and an audit checklist.
